messages:
ashley.k: Heads up — customer on Dedicated noticed experiment exp-2026-03 shows total exposures in the dashboard (Analytics > Rollouts) that don't match the raw assignment ledger. Dashboard sums to 1,200 but ledger query returns 2,450. Can we triage?
jun.lee: ack. can you paste repro steps + the exact experiment id and time window? any screenshots?
ashley.k: exp-2026-03, window 2026-03-10 00:00 -> 2026-03-11 00:00 UTC. Steps: 1) Open Rollouts > exp-2026-03 > Overview 2) Inspect exposure chart and cohort table (shows Variant A: 900, Variant B: 300) 3) Run ledger query: ```SELECT variant, count(*) FROM assignment_ledger WHERE experiment_id='exp-2026-03' AND created_at >= '2026-03-10' AND created_at < '2026-03-11' GROUP BY variant;``` returns Variant A: 1,300, Variant B: 1,150.
ashley.k: screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/prod/exp-2026-03-cohort.png (note the cohort rows look like labels and counts are shifted right compared to the bar chart)
alerts-bot: Ingestion pipeline notice: daily-rollup-job for experiments completed with warnings at 2026-03-10 00:05 UTC. Warning: "schema_version_mismatch for cohort_meta (v3 expected, v2 found)"
lisa.m: interesting — warning about cohort_meta schema could cause the UI to map labels incorrectly. cc @raman.s who owns analytics ingestion.
raman.s: I saw the rollup warnings last night. I rolled a fix for the schema patch but the rollback migration ran after the UI snapshot job. Suspect stale cohort_key -> variant_key mapping during the dashboard rollup. Will check mapping table.
jun.lee: can you run a quick sanity query to compare join keys? something like: ```SELECT a.variant_key AS ledger_key, c.variant_key AS cohort_key, count(*) FROM assignment_ledger a LEFT JOIN cohort_keys c ON a.cohort_id = c.id WHERE a.experiment_id='exp-2026-03' AND a.created_at >= '2026-03-10' AND a.created_at < '2026-03-11' GROUP BY 1,2;```
raman.s: running now. output snippet: ```ledger_key | cohort_key | count
--------------------------------
A_v2 | A_v1 | 1300
B_v2 | B_v1 | 1150
NULL | A_v1 | 0``` This shows ledger is using normalized keys (v2) but cohort mapping used v1 during the dashboard aggregation.
lisa.m: that explains the shifted counts — UI joined on the wrong key version and mapped counts to the wrong bucket labels.
ashley.k: customer is asking for immediate correction and whether impacted runs since 2026-03-09 need reprocessing. any quick mitigations? they want accurate metrics in console now.
raman.s: short-term: regenerate the dashboard materialized view for that experiment using the ledger keys (bypass cohort table) so counts come straight from assignment_ledger. I can run a rebuild for the affected experiments. Longer-term: ensure rollup job waits for cohort schema migration to complete, and add a pre-check that fails fast.
jun.lee: please include exact DB statements/commands so support can communicate back and so we have reproducible steps.
raman.s: command I will run: ```BEGIN; DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS analytics.rollup_exp_2026_03; CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW analytics.rollup_exp_2026_03 AS SELECT experiment_id, variant_key, count(*) as exposures FROM assignment_ledger WHERE experiment_id='exp-2026-03' AND created_at >= '2026-03-10' AND created_at < '2026-03-11' GROUP BY experiment_id, variant_key; REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW analytics.rollup_exp_2026_03; COMMIT;```
raman.s: kicking that off now. ETA ~ 2m. setting a postmortem ticket: ENG-ANALYTICS-734.
alerts-bot: Job analytics.rollup_exp_2026_03 refresh completed successfully at 2026-03-17 14:12:34 UTC
lisa.m: I verified the dashboard numbers after regen — matches ledger now (A:1300, B:1150). forwarding fix to the customer.
ashley.k: customer update sent, they requested a breakdown of impacted experiments and whether any automated alerts fired.
jun.lee: action items: 1) Raman to run backfill for 2026-03-08..2026-03-12 (raman.s) 2) Eng-platform to add migration gating for rollup jobs (lisa.m) 3) Support to send templated apology + data export (ashley.k). Tagging P1 and creating follow-up meeting.
raman.s: starting backfill job for 4 days now. Will post job id and progress. job id: backfill-2026-03-17-001
ashley.k: thanks. marking this resolved for now in support system; will reopen if customer sees further drift. :white_check_mark:
